gradeBand.title: Grade Band Label
gradeBand.description: Grade-band label for this Organizational Unit (used for diagnostics and anonymous aggregate analytics only).

masterEnabled.title: Master Protection Switch
masterEnabled.description: Enable or disable all Search Guard protections for this OU without uninstalling the extension. Defaults to true.

hideAiOverviews.title: Hide Google AI Overviews
hideAiOverviews.description: Suppress AI Overview summary boxes on Google Search results pages. Defaults to true.

hideAiModeUi.title: Hide AI Mode Buttons & Tabs
hideAiModeUi.description: Hide AI Mode buttons on the Google homepage, Search navigation bar, and 'Dive deeper in AI Mode' prompts. Defaults to true.

blockAiModeNavigation.title: Block & Redirect AI Mode URLs
blockAiModeNavigation.description: Silently redirect direct AI Mode URLs (?udm=50, google.com/ai, google.com/aimode) back to standard Google Search while preserving the query. Defaults to true.

forceWebOnlySearch.title: Force Classic Web-Only Search (udm=14)
forceWebOnlySearch.description: Redirect standard Google searches to classic Web-only results (udm=14) while preserving Images, Videos, Shopping, and News tabs. Note: udm=14 also hides Knowledge Panels, Calculator, and Dictionary cards. Defaults to true.

hideAuxiliaryAiFeatures.title: Hide Auxiliary AI Features (Labs, Lens, AI Follow-Ups)
hideAuxiliaryAiFeatures.description: Hide Search Labs triggers, Google Lens search-bar buttons, AI follow-up input bars, and AI-generated prompt cards. Defaults to true.

analyticsEnabled.title: Enable Optional District Google Sheets Analytics
analyticsEnabled.description: When true and analyticsEndpointUrl is set, periodically flushes strictly anonymous daily aggregate counts to your district's Google Apps Script Web App. Defaults to false.

analyticsEndpointUrl.title: District Google Apps Script Web App URL
analyticsEndpointUrl.description: Must match https://script.google.com/macros/s/<DEPLOYMENT_ID>/exec owned by your district.

analyticsSharedToken.title: Optional Shared Token for Apps Script Endpoint
analyticsSharedToken.description: Optional non-secret anti-spam token checked by your district's Code.gs webhook.

analyticsFlushIntervalMinutes.title: Analytics Flush Interval (Minutes)
analyticsFlushIntervalMinutes.description: Base interval between anonymous batch flushes (60 to 1440 minutes; plus 0-30 min random jitter). Defaults to 240.
